mentions.name: Video Hub App
mentions.description: Video Hub App is an application for browsing and organizing video files across local and network drives. An 8th anniversary release is delayed, with new features and bug fixes planned for a March/April release.
mentions.source_excerpt: Got delayed on my 8th anniversary release of Video Hub App - hoping to get it out in March / April. I have some bug fixes and new features in my app for browsing and organizing video files across local and network drives.
